overview.description: The Tuttle Capital Pure Play Photonics ETF (FOTO) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund is actively managed, investing in firms whose primary business operations are directly related to photonics. The fund focuses on businesses involved in technologies that generate, transmit, detect, and apply light across communications, sensing, imaging, manufacturing, and semiconductor applications. FOTO was launched on May 29, 2026 and is issued by Tuttle Capital.
